release_notes: Added Renderer Pulls as a first-class COLONY app: press RANDOM to generate a new renderer challenger.
Runnable Three/WebGL-derived pulls automatically connect to City Island and earn a live 0-100 performance score from real frame/render metrics; unimplemented architectures remain explicitly UNTESTED.
Live rarity bands: COMMON, RARE, EPIC, EXOTIC and LEGENDARY (95-100).
SAVE THIS PULL keeps only the current renderer you choose; saved renderers are searchable, reorderable, deletable and retain their latest measured score/metrics.
RUN asks which MOOR app/runtime to target. If the renderer is not compatible, COLONY generates the correct moor.render/1 builder prompt and copies it for GPT instead of faking a run.
Commands: renderer pulls, renderer gacha, renderer app, random renderer.
